llm_top3.reasoning: OVV pairs a top-5 quant rank with the cleanest fundamental news: S&P outlook upgrade on $2.2B debt paydown, accretive acreage deals, and a wave of target hikes into strong oil. FLEX's $4.4B EPC Power deal gives it credible, cash-generating AI-power-infrastructure exposure while shares have pulled back to support. I skip top-ranked VICI (dividend raise is real but the stock is making new 5-year lows on rate pressure) and TRU (rank 2 but facing a direct FHFA/VantageScore regulatory attack on pricing power) in favor of SO, where the approved 3,200 MW OpenAI contract is a concrete, regulator-blessed load-growth catalyst with utility downside protection.
